sentences.zh: 他看到了国会对布什总统日益增长的反对声浪。

sentences.en: The staff secretary essentially collates all the documents that flow to the president.
sentences.zh: 他看着布什总统的支持率直线下降。

sentences.en: These are the most sensitive documents on intelligence, on political analysis, on personnel matters.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他看到了一位总统正在经历几乎任何现代总统所面临的最可怕的压力。

sentences.en: So the staff secretary has perhaps an unrivaled window into the kinds of issues and pressures that are bearing down on a president every single day.
sentences.zh: 而且他在几年时间里，每天都在观察这一切。

sentences.en: And what is Kavanaugh seeing in these documents and in this role that causes his perspective to shift?
sentences.zh: 我认为卡瓦诺非常简单地意识到，总统的工作比美国政府中任何其他文职工作都要困难。

sentences.en: Well, Kavanaugh sees everything.
sentences.zh: 因此，应该受到不同的规则约束。

sentences.en: He's in the White House on the day of the 9-11 terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在多年后，即2009年撰写的一篇法律评论文章中，用非常生动的语言阐述了这一点。

sentences.en: He's actually ordered to flee the building with his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他说，总统在任期间不应受到刑事或民事调查或起诉。

sentences.en: He watches the ramp up in the war on terror, the war in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 如果他们犯了错误，可以在离任后被起诉并接受审判。

sentences.en: He is then on hand to see President Bush invade Iraq and around for the very negative blowback on the Iraq war when things start to go badly.
sentences.zh: 但在任期间，他们不应该受到必须回答问题的干扰和负担，不应该在履行总统职责的同时，头顶上还悬着法律的阴影。

sentences.en: He sees the mounting opposition to President Bush in Congress.
sentences.zh: 这就是他所说的。

sentences.en: He watches President Bush's popularity ratings plummet.
sentences.zh: 他说，这不一定是我在80年代或90年代的想法。

sentences.en: He sees a president, in short, going through the most dire pressures that face almost any modern-day president.
sentences.zh: 像当时许多美国人一样，我相信总统应该被要求承担我们所有人都承担的相同义务。

sentences.en: And he watches all of it every single day over a period of several years.
sentences.zh: 但回想起来，那似乎是个错误。

sentences.en: I think Kavanaugh realizes, very simply, that the job of president is more difficult than any other civilian job in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 例如，回顾20世纪90年代末，如果克林顿总统能够专注于奥萨马·本·拉登，而不被宝拉·琼斯性骚扰案及其刑事调查衍生出的问题所干扰，国家肯定会更好。

sentences.en: government.

sentences.en: And as such, should be subject to different rules.
sentences.zh: 因此，应该受到不同的规则约束。

sentences.en: And he actually lays out the case for this in very vivid language in a law review article he writes many years later in 2009.
sentences.zh: 他实际上在多年后，即2009年撰写的一篇法律评论文章中，用非常生动的语言阐述了这一点。

sentences.en: He says, presidents should not be subject to criminal or civil investigation or indictment while they're in office.

sentences.en: If they are guilty of wrongdoing, they can be indicted and tried for wrongdoing once they leave office.

sentences.en: them while they are also performing the duties of president.

sentences.zh: 他说，这不一定是我在80年代或90年代的想法。

sentences.en: Like many Americans at that time, I believe that the president should be required to shoulder the same obligations that we all carry.

sentences.en: But in retrospect, that seems a mistake.

sentences.en: The Brett Kavanaugh who authored that report was an aggressive exponent of the idea that
sentences.zh: 撰写那份报告的布雷特·卡瓦诺曾是这一观点的积极拥护者，即

sentences.zh: 这对于一个已经身处他所认为的世界上最艰难工作的人来说，负担太重了。

sentences.zh: 那么，这一切将如何影响卡瓦诺在未来几周的

sentences.zh: 参议院确认听证会？

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 我承认这是一个克林顿总统本不应该承担的分心之事。

sentences.en: But the truth is, the experience that led to his change of heart was in the service of a Republican president, and the nomination he has now gotten was put through

sentences.en: When it comes to the Mueller investigation.

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 方式可能在最高法院的背景下迅速变得相关。

sentences.zh: 如果穆勒传唤总统，而总统以引用

sentences.en: Court.
